Project summary

Over 12 months in 2022-23, LOKI Infra renovated the Gujarat Smart School buildings in Limbayat, Surat. One team handled painting and waterproofing, structural crack repair, landscape development and the replacement of doors, windows and locks, all while the school remained in use.

Client
Gujarat Smart School project, municipal primary school
Location

Scope of work

Painting and waterproofing

Every interior and exterior repainted, with waterproofing treatments to keep moisture out and extend the life of the buildings.

Structural repair and redevelopment

Cracks, breaks and tears in walls repaired and redeveloped, leaving the buildings structurally sound as well as better looking.

Landscape development

New gardens and green spaces across the grounds, giving students better places to learn and play.

Building amenities

Windows, doors and locks replaced and restored for better security, safety and everyday comfort.

Why it matters

  • A working school. The buildings stayed in use during the works, so every package was planned around students’ safety.
  • One accountable team. Painting, waterproofing, repair, landscaping and fittings under a single contract.
  • Built to last. Waterproofing and structural repair address the causes of damage, not just the finish.
